description:
Latanoprost 0.005% Eye Drops — 2.5ml Bottle (Generic for Xalatan®) is an ophthalmic preparation intended for application to the affected eye under the direction of an eye-care professional. Stored at controlled temperature in our Cabo facility for prompt delivery.

Usual administration involves instilling the prescribed number of drops in the affected eye(s) at the intervals specified by your physician. Wash hands before each application and avoid touching the dropper tip to any surface. Consult your healthcare provider regarding contact-lens use during treatment.

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1) before dispensing. Bilingual pharmacist support available throughout the Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo region.
